2608.20019.title: Contrastive Mixed Prompt Learning for Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Unseen Modality Combination
2608.20019.paper_summary: Incomplete multimodal sentiment analysis has garnered significant attention in recent years. Existing approaches typically assume that data is missing at random or are designed specifically for certain missing patterns, ignoring the modality combination inconsistency between training and testing phases. However, in real-world scenarios, the testing phase often encounters modal combinations that were not present during the training phase, which leads to insufficient generalization capabilities and unstable performance. In this paper, we introduce the problem of Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Unseen Modality Combinations (IMSAUMC), aiming to enhance model generalization for unseen modality combinations. To address this challenge, we propose the model named $\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{M}$ixed $\textbf{P}$rompt $\textbf{L}$earning ($\textsf{CMPL}$) for IMSAUMC. It introduces a label-guided contrastive feature learning mechanism to learn robust and discriminative cross-modal representations. Additionally, we design modality-combination prompts with a soft router to facilitate better learning of various modality combinations. Furthermore, we introduce three prompt contrastive learning strategies, which enable effective learning of prompts corresponding to unseen modality combinations, thereby significantly strengthening the model's generalization capabilities in diverse testing scenarios. Extensive experiments on three widely used datasets demonstrate that $\textsf{CMPL}$ achieves more than a 5% improvement in accuracy compared to state-of-the-art approaches.
2608.20019.paper_summary_zh: 不完整的多模態情感分析在近年來引起了相當大的關注。現有的方法通常假設數據是隨機缺失的，或者專門針對某些缺失模式設計，忽略了訓練和測試階段之間的模態組合不一致性。然後，在現實場景中，測試階段經常遇到訓練階段中不存在的模態組合，這導致了不足的泛化能力和不穩定的性能。在本文中，我們引入了未見模態組合的不完整多模態情感分析問題（IMSAUMC），旨在增強模型對未見模態組合的泛化能力。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了一個名為 $\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{M}$ixed $\textbf{P}$rompt $\textbf{L}$earning ($\textsf{CMPL}$) 的模型，專門針對IMSAUMC。它引入了一種標籤引導的對比特徵學習機制，以學習穩健且具區分性的跨模態表示。此外，我們設計了帶有軟路由器的模態組合提示，以促進對各種模態組合的更好學習。此外，我們引入了三種提示對比學習策略，使得有效學習對應於未見模態組合的提示，從而顯著增強模型在多樣化測試場景中的泛化能力。在三個廣泛使用的數據集上進行的廣泛實驗表明，$\textsf{CMPL}$ 在準確性上比最先進的方法提高了超過5%。
